surveyed.source: Backlog destination "De Schreeuw" (extract_landmarks_889547307, 52.35959 N 4.92236 E); the statue itself stands 10 m SW of that point at 52.35953 N 4.92226 E (three panoramas of 2016 and 2020, ray intersection, +-4 m, so the anchor is the intersection); the seven stainless blades and the plate read from Wikimedia Commons photographs (Ceescamel CC BY-SA 4.0; De schreeuw - oosterpark CC BY-SA 3.0); the facing (110 degrees, +-30) and the 3.7 m height are estimates
